description: This file defines the HuggingFaceHandler class, a provider for interacting with Hugging Face models via API, including methods for creating messages, completing prompts, and retrieving model info.

classes.name: HuggingFaceHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with Hugging Face models, extending BaseProvider and implementing SingleCompletionHandler.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the HuggingFaceHandler with API options, sets up the API client, and fetches model cache.

methods.name: fetchModels
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches available Hugging Face models and updates the cache.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message response from the model based on system prompt and messages.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the Hugging Face API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model information from cache or returns default model info.
